meal.name: Fisherman Soup
description: A disclosed Rivers-style Fisherman soup: fresh fish and shellfish in a cocoyam-thickened palm-oil broth with uziza.
Catfish, shelled clams, periwinkles and prawns form this selected fresh-seafood version.
reasons: Pounded cocoyam supplies the soup’s body.
Uziza seeds and leaves flavor the broth.
Fresh shellfish distinguish it from a clear pepper soup.

ingredients.name: fresh catfish, cleaned and cut into steaks
raw clam meat, commercially shelled and cleaned

instructions: Scrub cocoyam; inspect the cleaned seafood and keep chilled. Grind uziza seeds and pepper; wash and slice uziza and the debittered bitterleaf.
Cover cocoyam with its water, allow 5 minutes to boil and cook for about 25 minutes until soft. Drain, peel carefully and pound smooth, allowing 5 minutes.

Heat soup water, ground uziza, pepper and salt to a simmer for 5 minutes. Add catfish, clams, periwinkles and prawns; cook gently for an estimated 10 minutes until all are cooked, reaching at least 63 C. Lift out cooked seafood and keep covered briefly.

Add cocoyam in small lumps, palm oil and bitterleaf. Simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring until smooth. Return seafood and add uziza leaves; heat gently for 3 minutes. Adjust thickness and salt and serve.
